text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Thinking of refreshing my mind 
out in nature, I visited a mountain 
stream—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Uu... This is unexpectedly difficult.
choice_data_list: Air Messiah? What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asking her, she explained she came to 
catch critters to keep in her hobby 
mossarium.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Moss alone is plenty fascinating, but I 
thought having living creatures in it 
would broaden the world even further.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought I would try catching them 
myself, but... it doesn't go quite as 
planned.
choice_data_list: In that case, want to do it together?
Why don't we do it together then?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The trap preparations are ready. All 
that's left is for the two of us to drive 
them in.
choice_data_list: Alright, it went over to your side!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I-It came! Ah, wait, not that way...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, it got away.
choice_data_list:
It's okay, let's try as many times as it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, let's try once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a few more attempts, a fish finally 
entered the trap. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! The trap is broken... Just when I 
thought we finally caught it...
choice_data_list: Maybe this is as far as we go...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It can't be helped. I shall now execute 
our final resort.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... A-As expected, catching them 
barehanded is tough...
choice_data_list:
Is buying them at a store out of the 
question?
Would buying them at a shop not work?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Certainly, the result would be the 
same.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I gathered the moss for my 
mossarium myself. That is why I want to be 
particular about getting wild creatures 
too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just a hobby, I do not want 
to give up easily on something I have 
decided to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Besides, since Trainer-san even lent me a 
hand, I can give up even less.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So I will do everything I can— Ah! There's 
a fish over there...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Achoo...! Yes... I'm soaking wet, but 
unhurt.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's pull ourselves together and try once 
more... Oh? What is that over there...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A crab, isn't it? Fufu, how lovely. Though 
this little one seems weakened...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... from the shock when I 
slipped and fell...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: W-What have I done...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san, I am going to take this 
little one into my care.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A mossarium will pose no problem for 
raising a crab.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Unless I care for it at least until it 
recovers, I will feel far too guilty...
choice_data_list: I think you'll do great, Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I shall fulfill this 
responsibility thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please excuse me as I head back 
first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since this is my first time taking care of 
a crab, I must obtain care books and food 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah, treating even a tiny creature 
with sincerity and full responsibility. 
Her eyes were boundless in their 
gentleness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that our future course was decided, I 
suggested we head down the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, quite right. Catching a cold and 
becoming the one in need of care would 
hardly do.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let us head back before the sun goes down.
